headline: Medicare same-day pay cut worries specialists
pages: Medicare's 2027 physician pay update cuts the payment rate by 20% for certain services provided on the same day by the same physician or practice. The American Medical Association says podiatrists, dermatologists and otolaryngologists lose the most. Opponents say the change will force patients into separate visits, raise out-of-pocket costs and lengthen waits, especially in rural areas. A California podiatrist said her practice shelved plans to hire another doctor. A CMS spokesperson said the billing code changes aim to modernize Medicare and reduce administrative burden.

The Medicare Payment Advisory Commission supports the change, saying it removes duplicate payments, and the Justice Department has found fraud involving the billing code. The cut was slated to be 50% when first proposed in 2018 but was softened after backlash. Source: STAT News.
